## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Deformations
//
// Core catalog of analytic space warps. Each type implements IDeformation2D or
// IDeformation3D and is evaluated by `Eval` in `deformations.library.plato`.
// Parameters are world-space (origin + axis/rate); bounds-normalized variants
// can wrap these later. Zero rate / zero strength is the identity. Related SDF
// domain ops live in `implicit-sdf.types.plato` (often the inverse map).
// Classic Barr trio: Twist / Bend / Taper
// (https://doi.org/10.1145/800031.808573).

//==
// Twists space about Axis through Origin: each slice perpendicular to the axis
// rotates by AnglePerUnit times signed distance along the axis.
type Twist3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    AnglePerUnit: Angle;
}

//==
// Cheap circular bend (IQ opCheapBend generalized): points rotate about Axis
// through Origin by Curvature times signed distance along Direction.
// Precondition: Axis and Direction are unit and not parallel.
type Bend3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Direction: Direction3D;
    Curvature: Number;
}

//==
// Linear taper about Axis through Origin: the component perpendicular to the
// axis is scaled by (1 + Rate * t), where t is signed distance along the axis.
// Rate of 0 is the identity; negative Rate pinches.
type Taper3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Rate: Number;
}

//==
// Shears space: translates each point by Rate * t, where t is signed distance
// from Origin along Axis. Rate of zero is the identity.
type Shear3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Rate: Vector3D;
}

//==
// Blends each point toward the sphere of Radius about Center. Strength in
// [0, 1]: 0 leaves the point unchanged, 1 places it on (or toward) the sphere
// along the radial ray from Center.
type Spherify3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}

//==
// Planar shear: translates each point by Rate * t, where t is signed distance
// from Origin along Axis.
type Shear2D
    implements IValue, IDeformation2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    Axis: Direction2D;
    Rate: Vector2D;
}

//==
// Linear planar taper about Axis through Origin: the perpendicular component is
// scaled by (1 + Rate * t).
type Taper2D
    implements IValue, IDeformation2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    Axis: Direction2D;
    Rate: Number;
}

//==
// Swirl about Origin: rotates each point by AnglePerUnit times its distance
// from Origin (polar twist).
type Twist2D
    implements IValue, IDeformation2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    AnglePerUnit: Angle;
}

//==
// A planar deformation defined by an arbitrary point map. Carrier for Compose /
// Multiply results (and any other combinator that builds a Function1).
type MappingDeformation2D
    implements IValue, IDeformation2D
{
    Mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>;
}

//==
// A spatial deformation defined by an arbitrary point map. Carrier for Compose /
// Multiply results (and any other combinator that builds a Function1).
type MappingDeformation3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>;
}
```
